title: An open outcome is no conversational price

captions.physics: Returning to an invitation’s new meaning
captions.energy: Clarifying conversation tied to desired outcomes

meaning: You can return to an invitation’s new meaning and clarify conversation tied to a desired outcome, feeling hope without compulsory future agreement.
text: On your Vishuddha, Judgement in the physical position appears in returning to an invitation to discuss whose meaning is now understood differently. The Devil in energy supports readiness to clarify honestly conversation tied to a desired outcome. The Star in emotions brings hope without compulsory agreement. You can hear a wish for an actual exchange and notice a condition restricting its result. Possible continuation promises no identical positions on everything.

For example, you return to “Let us discuss it again”, previously heard as asking to repeat an answer already chosen. Interest in an actual position becomes clear, but “Only if we agree by the end” remains. **Living conversation is not paid for through a predetermined conclusion**. You can name this connection and leave the result open. Hope emerges for another exchange. Yet uncertainty does not make it meaningless: reasons can be understood without promising identical final words or abandoning every earlier doubt.

Difficulty arises if hope still sounds like a gentle guarantee that the required agreement will eventually appear. A pleasant future restores the condition instead of a direct demand. The constructive side of the Devil helps notice this tie again without rejecting genuine interest in understanding. You can want agreement without making it participation’s price; openness requires neither compulsory difference nor a promise that every exchange moves only towards a predetermined wanted answer.
